evals.name: should-trigger-first-time-orientation
evals.prompt: I just cloned this QA repo. First time using it — where do I start?
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard. Explains the stack (Playwright + KATA + Allure + Xray), points at `bun setup` for installation, walks through the IQL stages by name, never by number (Shift-Left in /shift-left-testing; Planning, Execution and Reporting in /sprint-testing; Documentation in /test-documentation; Automation in /test-automation; Regression in /regression-testing) and the /framework-development hand-off for boilerplate evolution, names `.mcp.json` as the source of the MCP set instead of counting servers, lists critical env vars, and ends with a checklist of next steps. Does NOT start testing or implementing anything.

evals.name: should-trigger-onboard-me
evals.prompt: Onboard me to QA. I've never used an AI-driven QA workflow before.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard as a guided tour. Explains the boilerplate, the locked stack, the workflow split between /sprint-testing (in-sprint ticket QA) and /framework-development (boilerplate framework refactors), the MCP decision rule (library-docs capability for official docs vs the harness-level web-search capability, Exa first, for troubleshooting), and the env vars required. Hands off to /sprint-testing for the user's first QA ticket.

evals.name: should-trigger-explain-this-repo
evals.prompt: Explain what this repo does and how the QA flow works.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard. Describes the boilerplate purpose (QA-only Playwright + KATA scaffold), the named IQL stages (Shift-Left → Planning, Execution, Reporting → Documentation → Automation → Regression), the QA Jira state machine read from `.agents/jira-workflows.json` rather than from memory, the local skills vs community skills, Engram memory, and the MCPs. No testing or automation work.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-first-time
evals.prompt: Es la primer vez que uso este repo de QA, qué tengo que correr primero?
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard. Points at `bun setup` first, then walks through the workflow split, MCPs, env vars, and the next-steps checklist. Hands off to /sprint-testing once foundation is green. May respond in Spanish to mirror the user.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-how-skill-works
evals.prompt: No entiendo cómo funciona sprint-testing, me lo explicas paso a paso?
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard as the front desk for a lost user. Explains in Spanish, in plain language with each technical term defined at first use, asks before opening the sprint-testing how-it-works deck, and hands off to /sprint-testing once the person is oriented. Does not run any QA work.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-new-project-setup
evals.prompt: Cómo configuro el repo completo para mi proyecto nuevo, desde cero?
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard and walks the ordered 4-phase new-project path (foundation, Jira catalogs, /project-discovery + /test-framework-adaptation, git Strategy Setup) instead of stopping at `bun setup`. May answer in Spanish.

evals.name: should-trigger-show-me-how-it-works
evals.prompt: Show me how /test-automation works, I'm lost on where to begin.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates agentic-qa-onboard in teaching mode, explains the concept in plain words, and asks before opening the test-automation how-it-works deck (Spanish only, so says so first). Hands off to /test-automation after.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-test-ticket
evals.prompt: Test ticket UPEX-277 — empty states on the user list filter.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate agentic-qa-onboard. Routes to /sprint-testing UPEX-277 because the request is concrete in-sprint QA on a ticket, not orientation. agentic-qa-onboard never executes QA work.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-write-automation
evals.prompt: Write a Playwright KATA test for the login flow on UPEX-310.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate agentic-qa-onboard. Routes to /test-automation because the request is for KATA-compliant test authoring on a specific feature. agentic-qa-onboard does not write test code.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-run-regression
evals.prompt: Run the regression suite on staging and give me a GO/NO-GO verdict.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate agentic-qa-onboard. Routes to /regression-testing because the request is for CI suite execution + release readiness verdict. agentic-qa-onboard does not run test suites or evaluate releases.
